description: Open the drawer, grip the blue block, let go of it in the drawer, close the drawer, in one fixed scene with one block. The latent switch, the oracle switch and the base policy, from the same start scenes. The config is made by dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py from calvin_exp_configs_examples/tasks/single_block_drawer.json. Run on the workstation from DynaGuide-main, see dynaguide_scripts/run_single_block_drawer.bat
